answer: A bond is refunded only after 16 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The beacon counter is kept in sonnet and raven shows each reset. An attacker therefore has to keep each alias continuously active for 16 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 1863 identities would post 2913 proofs and burn roughly 73 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
